declarations.description:
A resource timeline: people, rooms or machines down the side, time across the top, each booking a bar on its
resource's row (the resource view of FullCalendar or Google Calendar's room view).

`resources` lists the rows (`{ id, label, group?, description?, avatar?, color? }`); resources sharing a `group`
sit under a group row that collapses. `events` lists the bookings (`{ id, resource, start, end, title, color?,
readonly? }`) with wall-clock `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` times. Bookings that overlap on one resource stack in lanes and
the row grows to fit them.

`view` is `day` (one column per `slot-minutes`), `week` or `month` (one column per day) around `date`
(`YYYY-MM-DD`, today when empty). `day-start` and `day-end` bound the hours drawn, and `scroll-time` is where the
day view opens. In the day view the hours outside `working-hours` are shaded; every view shades the locale's
weekend. A line marks the current time in `time-zone`, under the bars. The header holds the range, previous /
Today / next buttons and a Day | Week | Month switch; they set `date` and `view` and fire `date-change` and
`view-change`. `hide-header` drops it for an app that drives the range from its own toolbar.

With `editable` the user arranges bookings, and the scheduler reports what they asked for; it never changes
`events` itself, the app does:
- Dragging across empty time fires `range-select` with `{ resource, start, end }`, snapped to `snap-minutes`; a
  click selects the column under the pointer.
- Dragging a bar moves it in time and to another row; dragging either edge resizes it. Both fire `event-change`
  with `{ event, start, end, resource }`. A preview follows the pointer, and Escape cancels.
- `readonly` bookings stay in place. `event-click` fires on any bar.

The grid is one Tab stop. On empty time the arrow keys move a slot cursor (Enter fires `range-select` for the
slot); moving onto a bar focuses it. On a bar, with `editable`, Left/Right move it by `snap-minutes`,
Shift+Left/Right change its end and Alt+Up/Down move it to the previous or next resource; Up/Down go to the next
row and Escape back to the slot cursor. Each bar is named by its title, resource and time, and moves are
announced.

members.name: resources
members.description: The rows: `{ id, label, group?, description?, avatar?, color? }`. Accepts a JSON string as an attribute.

members.name: events
members.description: The bookings: `{ id, resource, start, end, title, color?, readonly? }`. Accepts a JSON string as an attribute.

members.name: date
members.description: A day of the range shown, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to today in `time-zone`.

members.name: view
members.description: `day`, `week` or `month`.

members.name: dayStart
members.description: First hour drawn each day, `HH:mm`.

members.name: dayEnd
members.description: Last hour drawn each day, `HH:mm` (`24:00` for midnight).

members.name: scrollTime
members.description: Where the day view scrolls to when it is first drawn, `HH:mm`.

members.name: slotMinutes
members.description: Minutes per column in the day view; also the slot the keyboard cursor and a click select.

members.name: snapMinutes
members.description: Step, in minutes, that drags and keyboard moves snap to.

members.name: workingHours
members.description: Working hours, `HH:mm-HH:mm`; the day view shades the hours outside them. Empty shades none.

members.name: timeZone
members.description: IANA time zone the current-time line and Today follow, e.g. `Europe/Paris`. Empty means the browser's own.

members.name: editable
members.description: Lets the user create, move and resize bookings; see `range-select` and `event-change`.

members.name: hideHeader
members.description: Hides the header for an app that drives `date` and `view` from its own controls.

members.name: resourceHeading
members.description: Header of the resource column. Defaults to "Resources" in the scheduler's language.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the grid. Defaults to "Schedule" in the scheduler's language.

members.name: locale
members.description: Language of dates and built-in text, e.g. `fr` or `en-GB`. Defaults to the nearest `lang`, else the browser's.

members.name: now
members.description: The wall clock now; unset until the first client render, so a server-rendered grid hydrates unchanged.

members.name: cursor
members.description: The roving focus target: a row's slot cursor, or a bar.

members.name: refocus
members.description: A bar to focus once the app has applied a keyboard move.

members.name: layout

type.text: { range: SchedulerRange; columns: SchedulerColumn[]; rows: Row[] } | null

members.description: The range and columns of the last render, which the pointer and keyboard handlers work in.

members.name: anchorDay
members.description: Midnight of `date`, else of today (the server's or the client's clock until the first render).

members.name: hourStyle
members.description: `2-digit` hours on a 24-hour clock (`09:00`), `numeric` on a 12-hour one (`9:00 AM`).

members.name: spoken
members.description: A range as read aloud: "Monday 9:00 to 10:30", or with both days when it spans several.

members.name: shown
members.description: A bar's visible time: "09:00–10:30" in one day, "Mon 08:00 – Tue 14:00" across days.

members.name: timeAt
members.description: The time under the pointer on a lane, snapped to `snap-minutes`.

members.name: resourceAt
members.description: The resource whose lane is under the pointer's height, or the nearest one.

members.name: handleGestureKey
members.description: Escape drops a drag in progress; the bar stays where it was.

members.name: neighbour
members.description: The row `step` rows away from `resource` among the resource rows shown.

members.name: renderOff
members.description: Stripes over non-working hours (day view) and the locale's weekend (every view).

members.name: defaultColumn
members.description: The column the cursor starts on: the one holding `scroll-time` in the day view, else the first.

events.name: range-select
events.description: With `editable`, a range of empty time was picked by dragging, clicking or Enter. `detail`: `{ resource, start, end }`.

events.name: event-change
events.description: With `editable`, a bar was moved or resized. `detail`: `{ event, start, end, resource }`; apply it to `events`.

events.name: event-click
events.description: A bar was clicked or activated with Enter or Space. `detail`: `{ event }`.
The header changed the range shown. `detail`: `{ date, view, start, end }`.
events.name: date-change

events.description: The view switch changed the view. `detail`: `{ date, view, start, end }`.
events.name: view-change
